title: Diagonalizability conjecture for premagic matrices
statement: Let $\mathbf{M}$ be a premagic matrix, and let its eigenvectors be the vectors associated with its eigenvalues. **Diagonalizability conjecture.** $\mathbf{M}$ is diagonalizable, and its eigenvectors have full rank. This is listed as an open problem based on computer simulations, with no mathematical proof given in the source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.08856

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2017).
source_name: Kardi Teknomo, “Premagic and Ideal Flow Matrices”, arXiv:1706.08856 (2018).
